findings.title: Direct provider API calls bypass Model Router in emergency alert service

evidence.observation: Direct calls to call_gemini and call_mistral using raw environment API keys instead of routing through local model router port 8891

proposed_action.description: Refactor emergency alert summarisation to use ModelRouterClient routes instead of direct Gemini/Mistral SDK calls

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures centralized model governance, fallbacks, observability, and audit tracking across alerts

findings.title: Model router call log file is missing

evidence.observation: router_status reports recent failures and requests, but call_log_exists is false for path /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl

proposed_action.description: Ensure the directory exists and write permissions are granted for model router call_log.jsonl creation

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility into LLM routing latency, call logs, error rates, and failure forensics

findings.title: Missing routing policy entry for task hq-evolution-external-fit

evidence.observation: configured_routes contains 22 task types including 'hq-evolution-external-fit', but routing_policy contains only 21 entries and lacks this route

proposed_action.description: Add explicit route configuration and keep-alive policy for hq-evolution-external-fit in routing_policy

findings.expected_benefit: Prevents unexpected fallbacks or routing failures during hq-evolution-external-fit execution

findings.title: Unimplemented Phase 5 logic and hardcoded anomaly stubs in platform-runtime

evidence.observation: Hardcoded empty anomalies list 'recent_anomalies = []' marked with TODO to query quality_anomalies table
Multiple TODO placeholders for Phase 5 Supabase authorization checking and memory integration

proposed_action.description: Implement the quality_anomalies Supabase query and resolve research command Phase 5 stubs

findings.expected_benefit: Replaces stubbed return values with actual database-backed anomaly detection and enforcement
